old_problem: The central injection command is absent; Gen2 belongs to two window labels, threshold zero makes `more than threshold` ambiguous, `(port)` is unresolved, and read-only register lines are described as clearing evidence.
disposition_reason: This is more than missing runtime identifiers. The approved generation policy determines the numeric test, no command establishes what CE stimulus crosses the bucket, and no authoritative transition or evidence-preserving clear semantics exists. ED-15 forbids a verdict without the policy/oracle and ED-16 forbids inventing a proprietary RAS injector or recovery. The review can preserve a safe skeleton, but must remain Pending/BLOCKED until the vendor/platform owner supplies those core semantics.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 35, its DeepSeek data, historical record 2438 and next pending row 36.
Preserved the above-threshold PCIe leaky-bucket/degradation identity, distinct from memory decay and eDPC.
Rejected overlapping Gen2 labels, zero-threshold arithmetic and the example socket1/port2 path as executable inputs.
Treated apparent register reads as evidence only, not unproven clear operations.
No register clear, injection or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: PCIe above-threshold leaky-bucket and degradation policy
test_case.purpose: On a mapped PCIe link, cross the authoritative generation-specific correctable-error threshold by a bounded approved margin and verify the defined bucket/degradation transition and recovery.
required_package: Corrected BER/window/threshold/degradation matrix for every supported generation
Physical slot/root-port/BDF to versioned register path
Supported Intel injector hash, exact CE command and bounded count arithmetic
Decoded bucket/link transition and evidence-preserving baseline semantics
Endpoint quiesce, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the source recipe. Once the missing authority exists, capture the current generation and immutable baseline, calculate threshold plus approved margin, run one vendor-defined CE campaign on the mapped idle endpoint, collect raw/decoded bucket and link transitions, then recover and restore without clearing prior evidence unless the specification explicitly authorizes it.
test_case.expected_result: The signed policy's above-threshold bucket state and link/degradation response occur on the intended endpoint, remain bounded and recover as specified, while the host and device return healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is defined until the corrected generation matrix, actual injector/count, decoded transition and recovery are approved. Generic PCIe CE logs, guessed zero-threshold counts, ambiguous Gen2 policy or unproven clears cannot pass.
safety_gate: No stimulus until target, generation, policy, command and count are signed.
Abort on wrong path, fatal escalation, unexpected link loss/reset or unbounded response.
Never erase baseline evidence or automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Approved policy matrix and target/register map
Package hash, exact command and count calculation
Applicable platform records, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: Recovery is not yet authoritative. The owner must define how to restore link/device/policy after threshold crossing without destroying diagnostic state; absence of that procedure keeps execution blocked.
